body.x: SuperTooth, a leading manufacturer of portable audio accessories, will launch two exciting new Bluetooth accessories at the hugely anticipated CES 2013 (LVCC, South Hall 3, Stand 30769) and ShowStoppers event (Stand B19). The DISCO TWIN Bluetooth stereo speaker and HD-VOICE in-car speakerphone will be on show during the duration of both events allowing visitors to the stand to get hands on with the latest in wireless portable audio and hands-free technology.
DISCO TWIN – double the outstanding sound

Following on from the success of the recently launched DISCO2, the portable yet stylish SuperTooth DISCO TWIN features not one, but two slim and funky 16 watt Bluetooth speakers, delivering a huge 32 watts of sound, for a true right / left stereo effect. Promising the ultimate in wireless stereo sound, this compact speaker system operates using Bluetooth version 3.0 and can stream music wirelessly from any Bluetooth A2DP device, ranging from a smartphone or tablet computer to an MP3 player.

Up to ten hours of music can be enjoyed on-the-go from a three hour charge. The DISCO TWIN speakers have an operating range of up to ten meters and can be controlled using any Bluetooth AVRCP device. With its two powerful speakers on the front of each device and a high-efficiency bass-reflex system at the back of each unit, it is perfect for any indoor or outdoor space.

User-friendliness is at its maximum with HD-VOICE Bluetooth in-car speakerphone as it is equipped with voice features available in 12 languages - British English, American English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Mexican Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese, Russian, Japanese and Polish.

After choosing the desired language, HD-VOICE guides the user through the pairing process. When there is an incoming call, HD-VOICE says the name of the caller and the user simply has to say “OK" to pick it up. HD-VOICE also indicates the battery level and connection status, and announces GPS instructions from your smartphone. HD-VOICE can be connected with two phones simultaneously.

Featuring a dual speaker and dual microphone, the all-new HD-VOICE in-car speakerphone really packs a punch when it comes to talking on the go. Outstanding sound quality is had when in use for both the caller and receiver.

Using Bluetooth version 3.0, the HD-VOICE speakerphone is compatible with all mobile phones and smartphones boasting this technology. No installation is needed; it just clips to the sun visor and is ready to go so that users can safely talk when driving, without having a mobile phone illegally on their ear.
